operations.summary: Write the release directory (released.json only), the sealed file outside it and a draft data release manifest from the output of a blinding transform (core.blinding.transforms); the draft releases nothing (custodian: approval, full check, publication)

inputs.name: release
inputs.constraint: JSON from core.blinding.transforms (mode, released, sealed, protected, retained, parameters without key-like names)

inputs.name: meta
inputs.constraint: JSON with release_id, source, review, approval_ref, purposes, destinations, validity; optional composition_review

inputs.name: ledger
inputs.constraint: the custodian's release ledger; earlier releases of the analysis or source become related_releases

inputs.name: sealed_out
inputs.constraint: a file outside the release directory

inputs.name: manifest_out
inputs.constraint: outside the release directory; default next to it

inputs.name: analysis
inputs.constraint: the analysis name used to match ledger entries

inputs.name: code_digest
inputs.constraint: 64 hex; default the running plugin's code identity (refused when unknown)

failure_states.meaning: refused: not a transform output, incomplete META, key-like parameters, sealed file or manifest inside the release, release directory not empty, unknown code identity
an input file is unreadable or not JSON
protected use refused (status 'refused', core/protected/guard.py): the protected inputs could not be established
